long_biography.plain_text:
One&Only Reethi Rah opened in 2005 with Mohamed “Moho” Adil representing the Maldivian company behind the resort. During development, he held an indirect majority of Reethi Rah Resort and personally guaranteed its obligations under a subordinated financing agreement. The island lease and international management partnership placed him at the centre of a major private-island hospitality project.

Adil greeted the opening as chairman of Sultans of the Seas, while resort management remained with One&Only. Earlier, he had joined the Bank of Maldives board, serving for more than six years as his privately held interests expanded. His role combined local ownership, project-financing responsibility and strategic oversight while specialist hotel operations remained under the international brand.
